node_definition.done_when: Done when a new tests/test_a_run_owing_its_coordinator_keeps_the_pane.py drives live_work_populations over temporary live pointers. Each of these keeps its session live: a completed plan review run not yet promoted, a promotable run with its review stored, a run whose landing was refused, a run owing a repair, and a run that ended needs-help . The first two, once promoted, do not. A completed run owing nothing does not. A further case drives SessionHost.tick with a stubbed spawn and shows a settled child re-armed for the unpromoted review. The negative control restores the review-only rule, which makes every keep-live case except the review-owing one read as no work. The test files importing reckon.crew.station_subscriber or reckon.crew.session_host add no failure against the base revision, run one arm at a time with at most -n 4 . Ruff check and ruff format --check add no findings on the staged paths. Write paths: reckon/crew/station_subscriber.py and the new test.
